text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein says participation in government should be based on merit, not geography; cabinet post should not be combined with parliamentary seat.
- King phones Palestinian President Arafat, Prime Minister Kabariti delivers letter from king to Arafat during one-day visit to Gaza. Arafat due in Amman later Saturday to meet king.
- Hussein Majli elected head of lawyers' union for fourth term.
- Amman Investment Bank, which Central Bank took control of last week after accumulated losses, had been suspended from trading since October 1996, says head of stock exchange.
- Education minister says Jordan to provide Palestinians with technical expertise to build educational institutions.
- EU agrees to 10 regional projects which include Jordan.
- King offers Kabariti new mandate of "major reforms"; draws quidelines for shape and programme of next government; fighting stifling bureaucracy, separation of powers top list of priorities.
